comparison.objective: Use tweezers to move a wafer from a hotplate into a carrier and counterclockwise twist-lock the carrier; the candidate sets and locks a gripper opening stop.
comparison.physical_skill: PR-967 tests edge-only tweezer handling, sliding a flush wafer to obtain purchase, precision placement, lid seating, and bayonet rotation; the candidate tests driver/wrench seating and counterholding a screw against jam-nut torque.
comparison.success_condition: PR-967 requires a centred wafer, seated and counterclockwise-locked carrier, no prohibited wafer/hotplate contact, stillness, and clearance; the candidate requires retained opening angle across three cycles with low drift and both nuts retained.
comparison.reason: Wafer edge handling and bayonet closure test different abilities from locknut-secured angular calibration.
